Our Story

Meet

Tanner & Catherine (& Brooklyn)

Husband and wife in life (and business). We left our jobs in oil & gas and pharmaceutical sales and started a regenerative farm raising cattle, hogs, and chickens. We live in an old 1915 farmhouse we restored on 57 acres in Meyersville, Texas where our farm is located.

Meet

The Team

Starting with packing orders in a shipping container, over the past several years 1915 Farm has grown and now employs an entire team. We have three in shipping and fullfillment. Shawna is our Fullfillment and Customer Service Manager, and Faith is our shipping lead. Pictured in the center is Jaime, our lead farm hand. Not pictured is Austin, who works in both fulfillment and on the farm. 1915 would not be where it is today without this crew!

Our Why

In America, meat is considered a commodity - same as coal, oil, and crops. Our mission is to change that, one living and breathing animal at a time. We do not sell livestock that has been crammed into feedlots and confinement barns, fed the cheapest feed possible, full of sub therapeutic drugs to compensate for poor living conditions and quicker growth rates. We believe in feeding our community with meats that have been raised as close to nature is possible - out on pasture.

Our How

Our grass-fed beef, chicken, and heritage breed pork is raised here in Texas and on pasture. Our animals have room to roam - rooting, grazing, and pecking at the grasses, bugs, and whatever else they find in the sunshine. They are not given hormones or sub therapeutic antibiotics. Our feed blend for our chickens and hogs is corn and soy free. Our livestock is rotated throughout the pastures, allowing ample time between rotations for the soil and grasses to regenerate.

Shipping Pasture Raised and Grassfed Meats from our Texas Farm

We ship our grassfed, pasture raised beef, pork, and chicken directly to your doorstep from our small farm in Meyersville, Texas. Our meat is vacuum sealed, frozen, and shipped with plenty of dry ice in an insulated cooler box. 

Our quick transit time and careful packing ensures your order arrives at your door fully frozen, even during the summer...(including Texas summer days when it's 105°, sunny, and humid)!

Shipping Rates by State: 

 Texas 

Grassroots Club Shipping: FREE
Standard Meat Shipping  $29.99
Shirts/Non-Meat Orders: $12.99

 AL, AR, FL, GA, KS, LA, MO, MS, OK, TN

Grassroots Club Shipping: $14.99
Standard Meat Shipping $29.99
Shirts/Non-Meat Orders: $12.99

GA, FL, KY, TN

Grassroots Club Shipping: $39.99
Standard Meat Shipping $59.99
Shirts/Non-Meat Orders: $12.99

Rest of the States

Grassroots Club Shipping: $59.99
Standard Meat Shipping: $79.99
Shirts/Non-Meat Orders: $12.99

More Info on Shipping:

Our farm is located near Victoria, Texas – a few hours from Houston, Austin, Corpus Christi, and San Antonio. For our Texan neighbors, farm to doorstep transit time is just one day. The Dallas-Fort Worth area is a 2 days transit time.

Outside states receive their orders within two to three days. We hand-pack your orders carefully with plenty of dry ice to ensure your pasture raised and grassfed meats stay nice and frozen during their journey from our small Texas farm! 

If you're not home to receive your order, no worries! Signature is not required, and your meat will stay nice and frosty until you're able to transfer it to the freezer later the same day.

We ship orders every Monday, Tuesday, & Wednesday with an estimated delivery date to your front door within 1–3 days. Once we create the shipping label, you'll receive a UPS tracking number via email to track your order anytime.

Same Week Delivery Order Deadlines:

The order deadline for Texas orders is every Tuesday at 11 AM CST. 

For orders outside the state of Texas, the deadline is Sunday at midnight.

Orders placed after these deadlines will ship the following the week.
